success_definition: At least1 continuous second at height .23-.33m, tilt<=20deg, both driven wheels contact>1N and chassis/guide support<1N; no safety reset. Eight sample poses, not a universal capability test.
termination_handling: Native task terminations recorded; standalone recovery permits contact/tilt while standing up. Original numerical/2mm closure/mimic guards still terminate and censor the individual sample. No post-reset success is counted.

full_DR_summary.stage: repaired Step7 plus startup body mass and explicit motor output scale

delay.sampling: independent group lag at env reset; fixed within episode
delay.previous_action: last raw clamped policy output; execution delay does not overwrite it

body_mass_randomization.sampling: independent per environment and selected rigid body at startup; fixed across resets
body_mass_randomization.inertia: nominal inertia tensor scaled by that body's mass ratio
body_mass_randomization.critic_mass_slot: actual total robot mass divided by nominal total mass; existing 78D layout

effort_output_scale.sampling: independent per env/active motor, first reset and eligible reset after 720 global policy steps
effort_output_scale.application: full raw PD torque multiplied before original DC envelope; inherited additive noise then final envelope
effort_output_scale.critic: existing stiffness/damping slots report effective PD gains; actual applied torque slot retained; 78D unchanged

contact_material.sampling: startup; independent per-env/per-shape bucket selection; selected properties fixed across resets
contact_material.critic: existing six slots: actual left/right wheel material triple; shape mean if multi-shape; no base/guide encoding; 78D retained

velocity_push.sampling: native EventManager interval; timer resampled on reset
velocity_push.semantics: add delta to world XY velocity; z and angular unchanged

full_DR_summary.base_com_sampling: startup; fixed across reset; nominal + immutable sample

pd_gains.sampling: first reset and eligible reset after720 global policy steps
pd_gains.passive: native nominal damping * scale; zero stiffness remains zero
pd_gains.gas: plant stiffness2000 retained; native damping3*[.5,1.5]; no second damping torque

full_DR_summary.joint_friction_sampling: startup independently by selected joint; fixed across resets

reset_distribution.joint_position_source: MOD4 original exact linkage solver; bank generated only on physical feasible branch
reset_distribution.passive_velocity: closure-consistent kinematic tangent, not independently random joint velocities

bank.adaptation: reference uppergroundlength.36 exceeds MOD4 physicalreach; truncate to actual feasible max, no plant change

sampling_mixture.reset_distribution: same MOD4 feasible normal/ground distribution for both groups
